title: 3 October 2014: Ringo Starr live at Fabulous Fox Theatre, St Louis, Missouri
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Fabulous Fox Theatre in St Louis, Missouri, USA, on 3 October 2014.

It was the 32nd show of the 12th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 46 dates between June and October 2014.

Starr had previously performed at the Fox Theatre on 21 August 2001. He returned there on 7 September 2018 and 23 September 2023.

The 12th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion, keyboards
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar
  • Gregg Rolie: vocals, organ, keyboards
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, harmonica, bass, percussion, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Mark Rivera: vocals, saxophone, percussion, keyboards, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
